snippet.title: The Curse of the Zombiesaurus - Available Now
snippet.description:
Put a horde of Spooklings to work gathering bones, brimstone and slug shampoo in this macabre night-time land! Horrifying creations await you as you build your creepy kingdom and work out how to deal with the largest, most horrifying creation of all... the Zombiesaurus!

The Curse of the Zombiesaurus is downloadable content for A World of Keflings. Available Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3302330/A_World_of_Keflings__The_Curse_of_the_Zombiesaurus
